The explorer who reached America in 1492 is Christopher Columbus.

Regarding the text provided, it aligns strongly with the post-apocalyptic science fiction genre. The setting of a "former metropolis" reduced to "barren wastelands" and "ruins" is a staple trope of this genre, depicting a world after a catastrophic collapse. The presence of "warlords" and "scavenger gangs" further reinforces the lawless, survivalist themes common in post-apocalyptic narratives. Additionally, the protagonist's journey to find an "oasis" represents the classic quest for hope and renewal amidst desolation, a central thematic element in stories exploring human tenacity in the face of total environmental or societal breakdown.
